title: Serino 2015 · Experiment 7, virtual ball and touch
citation: Serino et al. (2015). Body part-centered and full body-centered peripersonal space representations. Scientific Reports, 5, 18603.
notes: Published study settings are available for inspection. See the source-backed method and remaining execution requirements.

published_method.response: Speeded gamepad response to touch. Compare distance-dependent facilitation between touch sites.

stimulus_type.value: Looming virtual 3D ball in an HMD.
stimulus_type.source: Article pp. 8–9 and 12, Experiment 7 and Fig. 6

source_provenance.source: Article pp. 8–9 and 12, Experiment 7 and Fig. 6
source_provenance.gap: Ball asset and original scene/settings unavailable.

trajectory_count.source: Article pp. 8–9 and 12, Experiment 7 and Fig. 6

trajectory_path.value: Virtual ball approaches the face and ends at fictive contact.
trajectory_path.source: Article pp. 8–9 and 12, Experiment 7 and Fig. 6

stimulus_duration.source: Article pp. 8–9 and 12, Experiment 7 and Fig. 6
stimulus_duration.gap: Approximately 2 m at 100 cm/s. Exact frame-level timing unreported.

auditory_conditions.source: Article pp. 8–9 and 12, Experiment 7 and Fig. 6
auditory_conditions.gap: Visual cue; no acoustic trajectory in this experiment.

gain_envelope.source: Article pp. 8–9 and 12, Experiment 7 and Fig. 6

renderer_or_apparatus.value: VR1280 HMD, 1280 × 1024, 60 Hz, 60° diagonal field of view. ExpyVR.
renderer_or_apparatus.source: Article pp. 8–9 and 12, Experiment 7 and Fig. 6

trial_rows_families.source: Article pp. 8–9 and 12, Experiment 7 and Fig. 6; Article pp. 12–13, Design and Analysis

condition_intermixing.value: Five to seven distance cells depending on experiment. Bimodal and unimodal control families.
condition_intermixing.gap: Exact scheduling across conditions and order unspecified.

blocked_or_random_order.gap: Experiment-specific blocks and randomization are recorded when explicitly reported. Exact randomization seeds unknown.

response_window.gap: Online response deadline and exact gamepad key unreported.

task_sequence_rules.value: Respond quickly to vibration with designated Xbox 360 gamepad button, sampled at 125 Hz. Ignore the moving cue and withhold on no-touch trials.

tactile_stimulus.source: Article pp. 8–9 and 12, Experiment 7 and Fig. 6
tactile_stimulus.gap: Same participants assessed at both sites.

soa_table.source: Article pp. 8–9 and 12, Experiment 7 and Fig. 6
soa_table.gap: Distances and nominal motion are reported. Exact software onset times, rendering origin and trigger delays are unavailable.

baseline_strategy.value: Two silent tactile timings equivalent to nearest and farthest bimodal samples. Subtract fastest mean tactile-only RT for each participant's comparison.

catch_trial_type.value: Visual-only cue from the methods design.
catch_trial_type.gap: Table 1 labels looming and receding catches, while the visual apparatus describes looming only. The Methods support visual-only catches; motion mix unclear.

catch_count.gap: 1 catch cell × 2 tactile sites × 16, without a direction split.

implementation_gaps: The delivered vibrotactile waveform, actuator acceleration and synchronized gamepad latency require calibration. The 100 ms pulse is the motor command duration.
A frame-synchronized visual scheduler is required for the looming ball and matched visual-only catches. Exact delivered frame/trigger timing is unreported.
reference_parameters.planner_scope: The study settings describe the source procedure. The Planner contains no executable trial schedule for this profile.
